title: KubeCon 2026 - travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for travel logistics, vendor contacts, and expense reminders for KubeCon North America 2026 (Booth #B14).

Status / high-level decisions:
- Booth confirmed: 10'x20' island (contract signed 2025-08-30).
- Shipping: crates outbound by FedEx Ground (ETA venue 2026-02-28).
- Team attending (confirmed): Samantha, Jordan, Alex. Pending: one more headcount (TBD by 2025-10-15).

Travel checklist (pre-departure):
- Book flights on company card (use corporate rate). Target arrival: 2026-03-01 morning.
- Reserve hotel: Hyatt Regency (room block code: REDWOOD_KC26). Confirmed block ends 2026-02-01.
- Submit pre-travel approval in Concur (attach initial estimate).
- Create shared Slack thread: #events-kubecon (already created). Pin this doc.
- Finalize booth build plan with vendor (see AV/booth contacts below).

Flights (notes):
- Book economy for 3 attendees; upgrade to premium if cost delta <$350 and flight >4.5h.
- Avoid red-eye for return; prefer evening return 2026-03-04.
- Frequent flyer programs: use personal FF for miles, but charge tickets to company card per policy.

Hotel (Hyatt Regency) contact:
- Group reservations: Maria Santos <maria.santos@hyatt.com>, +1-415-555-0102
- Block name/code: REDWOOD_KC26 (10 rooms reserved as of 2025-09-10)
- Check-in: 2026-03-01. Check-out: 2026-03-05.

Venue / shipping / freight:
- Venue logistics (Moscone Conference Center): logistics@moscone.com, +1-415-555-0220
- FedEx Freight rep: Carlos Mendez, carlos.mendez@fedex.com, +1-800-555-1337 (account on file: Redwood-Events-240)
- Crate labeling: "REDWOOD / KUBE24 / BOOTH B14" (double-check crate count before pickup)

Booth builder / AV vendor:
- Booth builder: Pacific Expo Services - contact: Kevin Ortiz <kevin@pacificexpo.com>, +1-206-555-0144. Lead time: 5 business days for on-site modifications.
- AV (lights/mics/display): SoundWave AV - contact: Priya Shah <priya@soundwaveav.com>, +1-619-555-0119. Send floorplan and run-of-show by 2026-02-15.
- Internet: Venue-provided 1Gbps best-effort; plan for bonded cellular backup (Cradlepoint). Quote requested from NetBackup LLC (waiting).

Booth schedule (tentative):
- 2026-02-28: Freight arrival window (confirm with FedEx).
- 2026-02-29: Booth build + AV install (crew on-site 8am-6pm).
- 2026-03-01: Final checks + staff orientation 3pm.
- 2026-03-02-03: Conference days.
- 2026-03-04: Break down after show close; freight pickup 8pm-midnight.

Expense guidelines / reminders:
- Save all itemized receipts (scan with Concur Mobile within 48 hours).
- Per diem: $75/day for meals (US domestic). No alcohol on meals charged to company unless pre-approved.
- Ground transport: use rideshare receipts (company card preferred).
- Booth-related expenses (shipping, drayage, AV, booth builder) should be coded to GL 4501 and project tag KUBECON2026.
- Submission deadline for reimbursement: within 30 days after travel end. Late submissions may be delayed.
- Expense report checklist: receipts, credit card statement lines, cost center, business purpose, attendees list for any meals >$75.

Formulas / budget estimates (rough):
- Flights: $450 x 3 = $1,350
- Hotel: $280/night x 4 rooms x 4 nights = $4,480
- Booth build + AV: est $12,000 (vendor quote pending)
- Shipping & drayage: est $1,800
- Meals/per diem: $75 x 3 ppl x 4 days = $900
- Incidentals/transport: $600
- TOTAL EST: ~$21,130 (budget owner: Events Marketing - confirm with finance)

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Get final booth-builder SOW & invoice (Kevin) - target 2025-11-01.
- [ ] Confirm bonded cellular backup quote from NetBackup LLC - follow up by 2025-10-10.
- [ ] Add fourth staffer (engineering demo lead) - finalize by 2025-10-15; will affect flights/hotel budget.
- [ ] Confirm shipping crate count with product ops (Jordan to confirm vehicle/storage).

On-site point persons / day-of contacts:
- Samantha Lee (events lead) - cell +1-415-555-0199, sam.lee@redwood.ai
- Jordan Kim (logistics) - cell +1-650-555-0188, jordan.kim@redwood.ai
- Alex Martinez (technical/demos) - cell +1-917-555-0177, alex.martinez@redwood.ai

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider swag: laptop stickers (2k), enamel pins (500) - need quotes (budget line?)
- Demo laptop list: 3 machines (macbook pro 14), ensure local model weights are redacted for demo builds to avoid IP exposure in public demo.
- Bring backup HDMI adapters, USB-C hubs, dongles, and power strips labeled with owner names.

Meeting slots to schedule during conference (draft):
- Mon 3/02 11:00-11:30 - Partner sync (Open Source Maintainers)
- Tue 3/03 14:00-14:30 - Sales intro: enterprise ops leads (book conference rooms via portal)

Quick reimbursement how-to (for team):
1) Scan/photograph receipts immediately.
2) Submit report in Concur, attach photos + credit card lines.
3) Tag cost center: 4501, project: KUBECON2026.
4) Add business purpose + attendee list for meals.
5) Notify finance (finance@redwood.ai) for expedited review if over $5k.

Slack/comms links:
- Slack channel: #events-kubecon (use for real-time day-of comms)
- Shared calendar: events.redwood.ai/kubecon-2026 (invite pending)

Last updated notes:
- 2025-10-03: Updated hotel block status and added AV vendor contact (Priya). Follow-ups assigned to Jordan and Kevin.

-- end of scratchpad --
